timeout_behavior.interpretation: The candidate survives beyond the idle interval while valid stream frames continue, then kills silent process groups. The baseline applies a wall-clock cap and kills every active run.

production_gigo_scouts.interpretation: The candidate used fewer tokens and was faster, but citation recall regressed and no result passed the Scout useful-result contract. No .codegraph index existed, so both arms had the same repository tools. Do not treat the latency or token difference as a tool benefit.
